theses.name: Moody's Corporation
theses.thesis: Ratings are booming on AI and infrastructure issuance and margins are expanding, but Analytics growth is mid-single-digit and the issuance mix is less lucrative.

signals.name: q2_beat_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue rose 15% to $2.19B and adjusted EPS rose 31% to $4.68; the adjusted EPS guide was raised to $16.50-17.00 and buyback guidance to up to $3B.

signals.name: mis_surge
signals.rationale: Ratings revenue jumped 25% to $1.3B on 33% higher rated issuance, driven by AI-related financing, private credit and infrastructure deals.

signals.name: analytics_slow
signals.rationale: Moody's Analytics revenue grew only 4% reported (8% organic constant currency) to about $925M.

signals.name: mix_less_rich
signals.rationale: Management did not raise MIS revenue guidance despite the issuance beat because the mix leaned toward lower-fee data center and financial institution deals.

theses.name: Mastercard
theses.thesis: Double-digit revenue growth on strong cross-border volume continues, while the merchant interchange settlement caps US credit pricing and pending legislation remains a regulatory overhang.

signals.name: q2_beat
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 net revenue rose 14% (12% currency-neutral) to about $9.3B and adjusted EPS rose 19% to $5.04, beating estimates.

signals.name: cross_border
signals.rationale: Cross-border volume grew 12% in local currency and gross dollar volume rose 8% to $2.9T.

signals.name: interchange_cap
signals.rationale: Mastercard's settlement with merchant class counsel caps US credit interchange for at least five years and loosens surcharging rules, limiting pricing upside.

signals.name: ccca_overhang
signals.rationale: The Credit Card Competition Act, which would require a second network option on large issuers' cards, remains a pending legislative risk.

theses.name: Morgan Stanley
theses.thesis: Record revenue from wealth management and equities trading with a sharply better efficiency ratio, but expenses are rising fast and part of the asset inflow was one-off IPO money.

signals.name: q2_record
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 net revenue rose to a record $21.3B from $16.8B, EPS was $3.46 and the efficiency ratio improved to 65% from 71%; equities trading rose 69% to about $6.3B.

signals.name: wealth_nna
signals.rationale: Wealth management revenue rose 14% to $8.9B at a 30.5% pretax margin, with record net new assets of $148B.

signals.name: expense_growth
signals.rationale: Compensation expense rose to $8.19B from $7.19B and non-compensation expense to $5.72B from $4.78B.

signals.name: one_off_inflows
signals.rationale: Just over half of the record net new assets came from client IPO-related workplace inflows, which are unlikely to recur every quarter.

theses.name: Lockheed Martin
theses.thesis: Execution has recovered after the 2025 program charges, with a raised guide, strong cash flow and a record backlog, but F-35 order timing and a sector de-rating weigh on the stock.

signals.name: q2_beat_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 EPS was $7.94; 2026 guidance was raised to $79.75-81.75B sales and $29.95-30.65 EPS, with free cash flow guidance lifted to $7.0-7.2B.

signals.name: aero_recovery
signals.rationale: Aeronautics sales rose 9.3% to $8.11B on higher F-35 volume, with operating profit of $760M versus a $98M loss a year earlier.

signals.name: f35_order_timing
signals.rationale: RBC flagged the timing of future F-35 production orders as a key risk after roughly $2B of program charges in 2025.

signals.name: td_cowen_cut
signals.rationale: TD Cowen cut its target to $570 from $600 with a Hold rating on Oct 9, 2026 as part of a sector-wide defense de-rating.

theses.name: KeyCorp
theses.thesis: NII and commercial loan growth guidance moved up as the margin expands, but charge-offs are rising and the market questions the deposit assumptions.

signals.name: nii_guide_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 EPS was $0.44 and NIM rose to 2.89%; full-year NII growth guidance was raised to 9-11% and commercial loan growth to 8-10%.

signals.name: charge_offs_up
signals.rationale: Net charge-offs rose to $115M from $102M a year earlier, a 42bp ratio.

signals.name: margin_skepticism
signals.rationale: Shares fell about 2.4% on results as analysts questioned margin and deposit assumptions behind the 3% NIM target.

theses.name: Yum! Brands
theses.thesis: Taco Bell is driving strong comps and KFC unit growth is robust, while Pizza Hut keeps shrinking ahead of its sale.

signals.name: taco_bell_strength
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 Taco Bell US same-store sales rose 7% and division operating profit rose 19%; EPS ex-special items rose to $1.62 from $1.44.

signals.name: kfc_unit_growth
signals.rationale: KFC opened 660 gross new restaurants across 55 countries, with unit growth of 7%.

signals.name: pizza_hut_decline
signals.rationale: Pizza Hut same-store sales fell 1% and system sales fell 2%.

signals.name: pizza_hut_sale
signals.rationale: Yum agreed to sell Pizza Hut outside China to LongRange Capital and the China business to Yum China.

theses.name: M&T Bank
theses.thesis: Record earnings, the best loan growth since 2012 and improving credit, though second-half NII is tracking toward the low end of guidance.

signals.name: q2_record
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 diluted EPS was a record $5.32 on $818M of net income; NII rose 2% sequentially to $1.8B with NIM steady at 3.70%.

signals.name: credit_improving
signals.rationale: Criticized loans fell for a ninth straight quarter and net charge-offs dropped to 23bp.

signals.name: nii_low_end
signals.rationale: Management expects second-half NII in the lower half of its $7.2-7.35B range.

theses.name: Super Micro Computer
theses.thesis: AI server demand and a sharp margin recovery support a huge FY27 revenue guide, but revenue missed and an export-smuggling case tied to company insiders is unresolved.

signals.name: margin_recovery_fy27_guide
signals.rationale: Fiscal Q4 2026 gross margin rose to 17.5% from 9.9% the prior quarter, non-GAAP EPS of $1.70 beat about $0.96, and FY27 revenue was guided to $65-72B.

signals.name: revenue_miss
signals.rationale: Q4 net sales of $11.1B landed near the low end of the $11-12.5B guide and below the roughly $11.5B consensus.

signals.name: smuggling_case
signals.rationale: A federal indictment charged three people tied to Supermicro, including co-founder Wally Liaw, with routing Nvidia-equipped servers to China; a contractor pleaded guilty in the case on Oct 9, 2026.

signals.name: margin_normalizes
signals.rationale: Analysts expect gross margin to fall back toward the low double digits next quarter as mix normalizes.

theses.name: Leidos Holdings
theses.thesis: Defense-tech and mission-support demand lifted guidance and bookings, but reported EPS declined year over year and organic growth is modest.

signals.name: q2_guide_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue rose 7% to $4.56B (4% organic); full-year revenue guidance was raised to $18.2-18.4B and non-GAAP EPS to $12.20-12.50.

signals.name: backlog
signals.rationale: Leidos booked $5B of awards in Q2 and ended with a $48.7B backlog.

signals.name: eps_decline
signals.rationale: Q2 net income fell to $356M and diluted EPS slipped 7% to $2.81.

theses.name: L3Harris Technologies
theses.thesis: Record backlog and strong EPS and cash-flow growth, offset by a sector-wide aerospace and defense de-rating that has analysts cutting targets.

signals.name: q2_record_backlog
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue rose 8% to $5.9B, diluted EPS rose 28% to $3.13 and orders of $7.3B (1.2x book-to-bill) lifted backlog to a record $42B; 2026 revenue and EPS guidance were raised.

signals.name: fcf_growth
signals.rationale: Q2 free cash flow rose 37% to $771M.

signals.name: td_cowen_target_cut
signals.rationale: TD Cowen cut its target to $280 from $370 on Oct 9, 2026 while keeping a Buy, calling the aerospace and defense de-rating 'disorderly'.

theses.name: Intuit
theses.thesis: Strong FY26 execution and heavy buybacks, but the FY27 outlook disappointed, TurboTax growth is slowing to low single digits and the stock was downgraded.

signals.name: fq4_beat
signals.rationale: Fiscal Q4 2026 revenue of $4.35B and adjusted EPS of $4.03 beat estimates; full-year revenue grew 14% and non-GAAP EPS rose 20% to $24.27.

signals.name: capital_returns
signals.rationale: Intuit repurchased $5.5B of stock in fiscal 2026 and raised its quarterly dividend 15% to $1.38.

signals.name: fy27_guide_miss
signals.rationale: FY27 revenue guidance of $23.28-23.51B (9-10% growth) slightly missed expectations and shares fell about 4%.

signals.name: turbotax_slowdown
signals.rationale: TurboTax growth is guided to just 2-3% as Intuit cuts entry-level pricing to win new customers.

theses.name: Johnson Controls
theses.thesis: Data-center thermal demand is driving record backlog and a raised guide, though EMEA is stalling and order growth is flattered by a definition change.

signals.name: q3_beat_raise
signals.rationale: Fiscal Q3 2026 organic sales rose 10% and adjusted EPS of $1.42 beat $1.30; FY26 guidance was raised to about $5.05 adjusted EPS and 8% organic growth.

signals.name: record_backlog
signals.rationale: Backlog reached a record $21.0B, up 32% organically, with Americas orders up 37% on data-center demand; the CDU pipeline topped $1B after Nvidia certification.

signals.name: emea_stall
signals.rationale: EMEA organic sales grew only about 1% in Q3, constrained by conflicts in the Middle East.

signals.name: orders_not_like_for_like
signals.rationale: Orders now include equipment-only sales for longer-cycle projects that were previously excluded, so year-over-year order growth is not strictly comparable.

theses.name: Veeva Systems
theses.thesis: Steady high-teens growth and a raised guide, with Vault CRM winning large pharma, while Salesforce's IQVIA-based Life Sciences Cloud competes for the same migration.

signals.name: q2_fy27_beat_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 17.6% to $928M and non-GAAP EPS was $2.35, both beats; FY27 revenue guidance was raised to $3.682-3.687B with non-GAAP EPS of about $9.21.

signals.name: vault_crm_adoption
signals.rationale: Vault CRM had more than 180 customers live, including five of the top 20 biopharma companies; BMS and Roche have committed to it.

signals.name: salesforce_competition
signals.rationale: Salesforce's Life Sciences Cloud, built on IQVIA's OCE CRM, has signed early adopters including Pfizer, Boehringer Ingelheim and Takeda, directly contesting Veeva's CRM migration.

theses.name: Seagate Technology
theses.thesis: HAMR and data-center demand drive record margins and capacity sold out through 2028, but the stock is volatile, richly valued and heavily sold by insiders.

signals.name: fq4_record
signals.rationale: Fiscal Q4 2026 revenue rose to $3.63B from $2.44B with 52.3% gross margin; non-GAAP EPS rose 121% to $5.71 and fiscal Q1 2027 was guided to about $4.1B revenue and $7.30 EPS.

signals.name: capacity_allocated
signals.rationale: Long-term agreements have allocated most nearline capacity through calendar 2028, and HAMR reached about 40% of nearline exabyte shipments.

signals.name: insider_selling_downgrade
signals.rationale: Insiders sold more than $126M of stock over three months, and Fox Advisors downgraded the shares to Equal-Weight.

signals.name: capex_digestion_risk
signals.rationale: A July 2026 selloff of more than 12% in one day reflected fears hyperscalers overbuilt AI capacity; the stock's beta is about 3.

theses.name: ServiceNow
theses.thesis: Q2 beat on subscription revenue, cRPO and AI deals, and the guide was raised, but Q3 guidance implies deceleration because federal deals were pulled forward.

signals.name: q2_beat_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 subscription revenue rose 24.5% to about $3.88B, roughly 150bp above guidance; cRPO grew 21% to $13.2B and full-year subscription guidance was raised to $15.76-15.78B.

signals.name: large_deals
signals.rationale: ServiceNow closed 123 deals over $1M in net new ACV, up nearly 40% year over year, and crossed $1B in AI-related ACV.

signals.name: q3_decel_pullforward
signals.rationale: Q3 guidance implies subscription growth slowing to about 20.5% and cRPO growth of 19.5%, as some federal on-prem revenue was pulled forward into Q2.

theses.name: Everest Group
theses.thesis: Reserves have stabilized and capital is being returned while retail insurance is exited, but catastrophe losses pushed the combined ratio up and Legacy still loses money.

signals.name: reserves_stable_buybacks
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 prior-year reserve development was zero versus $59M adverse a year earlier; net income was $559M and Everest repurchased $395M of stock.

signals.name: retail_exit
signals.rationale: Everest agreed in August 2026 to sell its Mexico operations to Fairfax, adding to the Canada and Colombia retail sales as it refocuses on reinsurance and wholesale.

signals.name: combined_ratio_up
signals.rationale: The group combined ratio rose 1.6 points to 92.0% as pre-tax catastrophe losses jumped to $94M from $20M.

signals.name: legacy_loss
signals.rationale: The Legacy segment posted a $36M underwriting loss in Q2.

theses.name: Williams-Sonoma
theses.thesis: Comps are accelerating across every brand and guidance was raised, but underlying gross margin is shrinking under tariffs and GAAP results are flattered by one-time refunds.

signals.name: comp_acceleration
signals.rationale: Q2 comparable brand revenue rose 6.2%, up from 4.8% in Q1, with every brand positive; revenue rose 6.7% and full-year guidance was raised.

signals.name: tariff_margin_hit
signals.rationale: Non-GAAP gross margin fell about 160bp to 45.5%, with tariff costs cutting merchandise margins by 230bp.

signals.name: one_time_refunds
signals.rationale: About $117M of net IEEPA tariff refunds lifted GAAP EPS to $2.84 versus $2.10 non-GAAP, a benefit that will not recur.

theses.name: IDEX Corporation
theses.thesis: Record orders led by Health & Science drove a guidance raise, though growth is concentrated in one segment while the other two are flat.

signals.name: record_orders
signals.rationale: Q2 orders topped $1B, up 28% organically, and sales were a record $921M (5% organic); adjusted EPS rose 12% to $2.32.

signals.name: guide_raise
signals.rationale: Full-year 2026 organic growth guidance was raised to 5-6% from 3-4% and adjusted EPS to $8.70-8.85 from $8.35-8.55.

signals.name: segments_flat
signals.rationale: Fluid & Metering grew only about 1% organically and Fire & Safety/Diversified declined about 1%; growth came almost entirely from Health & Science.

signals.name: tariff_rebate_hit
signals.rationale: A $9.3M reduction from customer rebates tied to IEEPA tariff refunds cut Q2 organic growth by 2 points.

theses.name: Hubbell Incorporated
theses.thesis: Grid modernization and data-center demand are driving double-digit organic growth and a raised guide, while operating margins are slipping.

signals.name: q2_organic_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 sales rose 15% to $1.712B with 10% organic growth; 2026 adjusted EPS guidance was raised to $20.25-20.55 with 9-11% organic growth.

signals.name: data_center_orders
signals.rationale: Management cited continued order-book strength as data-center and utility T&D investment accelerates; Electrical Solutions grew 18% organically.

signals.name: margin_contraction
signals.rationale: Adjusted operating margin fell 50bp to 23.9% and GAAP operating margin dropped to 20.4% from 22.7%.

signals.name: grid_automation_flat
signals.rationale: Grid Automation sales rose only about 1% while utility organic growth was about 6%, trailing the electrical segment.

theses.name: Honeywell Technologies
theses.thesis: After the June 2026 Aerospace spin, the remaining automation and building-tech company guides to strong EPS growth, but organic growth is only 2-3% and much of the margin gain is portfolio mix.

signals.name: standalone_eps_guide
signals.rationale: Honeywell Technologies' 2026 outlook calls for adjusted EPS of $3.95-4.15 (up 22-28%), 220-270bp of segment margin expansion and about $2.0B of free cash flow.

signals.name: aerospace_spin_done
signals.rationale: The Aerospace separation completed on June 29, 2026; PSS and Warehouse & Workflow divestitures are expected to close by Q4.

signals.name: low_organic_growth
signals.rationale: Standalone organic sales growth is guided to just 2-3%, a deceleration from the full company's prior 3-6% outlook.

signals.name: margin_is_mix
signals.rationale: Analysts argue the margin expansion largely reflects a lower comparative base after shedding Aerospace rather than operational improvement.

theses.name: Quest Diagnostics
theses.thesis: Double-digit organic growth and two guidance raises this year, with a Medicare lab fee cut scheduled for 2027 unless Congress acts.

signals.name: q2_beat_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 revenue rose 10.2% to $3.04B (10.0% organic) and adjusted EPS rose 19% to $3.12; 2026 guidance was raised to $11.95-12.05B revenue and $11.05-11.25 adjusted EPS.

signals.name: volume_growth
signals.rationale: Requisition volume rose 13% year over year as preventive testing demand grew.

signals.name: pama_cuts_2027
signals.rationale: CMS's preliminary 2027 lab fee schedule cuts rates about 16% on average, with 775 tests facing the maximum 15% cut, effective Jan 1, 2027 unless Congress delays it.

theses.name: Roper Technologies
theses.thesis: Organic growth and EPS guidance are improving, but the stock is roughly 40% off its high on AI-disruption fears and weak Deltek and DAT end markets.

signals.name: q2_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 revenue rose 9% to $2.11B (5% organic), adjusted EPS rose 10% to $5.38 and full-year adjusted EPS guidance was raised to $22.15-22.30.

signals.name: buybacks
signals.rationale: Roper repurchased 3.6M shares for $1.2B in Q2, $3.2B program to date.

signals.name: rbc_downgrade_ai
signals.rationale: RBC downgraded Roper to Sector Perform, cutting its target to $539 from $644 and citing AI as a threat to its application-software model.

signals.name: end_market_weak
signals.rationale: Deltek is pressured by government budget cuts and DAT by the freight downturn; the stock fell about 40% from its $584 52-week high.

theses.name: Xcel Energy
theses.thesis: Data-center load and a large capital plan support above-trend EPS growth, offset by financing drag and lingering wildfire liabilities.

signals.name: guide_reaffirmed
signals.rationale: Q2 EPS rose to $0.93 from $0.75 and 2026 ongoing EPS guidance of $4.04-4.16 was reaffirmed, with long-term growth of 6-8%+.

signals.name: data_center_load
signals.rationale: Management expects to secure an additional 4 GW of data-center load by end of 2027, at least 1 GW by year-end 2026.

signals.name: financing_drag
signals.rationale: Higher interest expense cut Q2 EPS by $0.12 and common-equity dilution by another $0.06.

signals.name: smokehouse_creek
signals.rationale: Xcel has recorded a total estimated loss of $460M before insurance for the Smokehouse Creek fire, excluding possible fines and punitive damages.

theses.name: FedEx
theses.thesis: Cost programs beat targets and the Freight spin-off is done, but the first post-spin earnings guide came in well below consensus.

signals.name: q4_fy26_beat
signals.rationale: Q4 FY26 adjusted EPS was $6.31 on $25.0B revenue, beating consensus; full-year adjusted EPS of $20.24 topped prior guidance.

signals.name: freight_spin_done
signals.rationale: FedEx completed the FedEx Freight spin-off on June 1, 2026, distributing 80.1% of FDXF shares and keeping a 19.9% stake to monetize within 24 months.

signals.name: guide_below_consensus
signals.rationale: The post-spin outlook for adjusted EPS of $16.90-18.10 fell short of the roughly $19.92 consensus.

theses.name: UnitedHealth Group
theses.thesis: Margin repair is ahead of plan with a lower medical care ratio and a raised 2026 guide, but part of the beat was reserve releases and regulatory scrutiny keeps widening.

signals.name: q2_mcr_guide_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 medical care ratio fell to 86.7% from 89.4%, adjusted EPS was $6.38 and full-year adjusted EPS guidance was raised to $19.50-20.00.

signals.name: prior_period_benefit
signals.rationale: The 86.7% MCR included $860M of net favorable prior-period medical development, flattering the underlying run-rate; the operating cost ratio rose to 12.7% from 12.3%.

signals.name: texas_ag_probe
signals.rationale: On Oct 5, 2026 the Texas Attorney General issued civil investigative demands to UnitedHealth over alleged coverage denials and deceptive trade practices.

theses.name: Salesforce
theses.thesis: A big Q2 EPS beat and a raised FY27 guide reignited the stock, but headline growth leans on Informatica and organic growth is running in the mid-to-high single digits.

signals.name: q2_fy27_beat_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 11% to $11.3B, non-GAAP EPS was $5.90 and cRPO grew 14% in constant currency to $33.5B; FY27 revenue guidance was raised to $46.1-46.4B.

signals.name: agentforce_bookings
signals.rationale: Management said bookings of its premium Agentforce One and Agentforce for Apps SKUs more than doubled quarter over quarter.

signals.name: informatica_inflates_growth
signals.rationale: Informatica contributed $456M of Q2 revenue, so headline 11% growth overstates the organic rate.

signals.name: organic_slowdown
signals.rationale: Analysts estimate organic growth has slowed to roughly 6-7%, putting more weight on cRPO holding up.

theses.name: Loews Corporation
theses.thesis: Conglomerate earnings are rising with strong Boardwalk and hotel results plus steady buybacks, while CNA underwriting softened.

signals.name: q2_earnings_up
signals.rationale: Q2 net income rose to $444M ($2.16/share) from $391M; Boardwalk earnings rose 14% to $100M and hotels earned $48M vs $28M.

signals.name: buybacks
signals.rationale: Loews repurchased 1.4M shares for $146M in the quarter, continuing to shrink the share count.

signals.name: cna_underwriting
signals.rationale: CNA's underlying underwriting results weakened in Q2, pressuring the largest earnings contributor.

theses.name: Ingersoll Rand
theses.thesis: Revenue guide raised on pricing and acquisitions, but margins contracted, EMEA orders fell and EPS guidance did not move up.

signals.name: rev_guide_up
signals.rationale: Ingersoll Rand raised 2026 revenue guidance to $8.00-8.15B.

signals.name: eps_guide_flat
signals.rationale: Adjusted EPS guidance was held at $3.45-3.57 despite the higher revenue outlook.

signals.name: margin_emea
signals.rationale: Adjusted EBITDA margin fell 160bp to 25.4%, EMEA orders declined low double digits and book-to-bill was 1.0x.

theses.name: Thermo Fisher Scientific
theses.thesis: Steady organic growth and a raised 2026 guide, with academic and government demand still depressed by US grant freezes and weak China academic spending.

signals.name: q2_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 revenue rose 10% to $11.99B (5% organic) and adjusted EPS rose 13% to $6.03; 2026 guidance was raised to $47.4-48.1B revenue and $24.93-25.33 EPS.

signals.name: academic_gov_weak
signals.rationale: Management said academic and government demand remains muted due to US grant freezes, and China academic demand is weak.

signals.name: eps_compounding
signals.rationale: Double-digit adjusted EPS growth on mid-single-digit organic growth shows continued margin execution.

theses.name: Qualcomm
theses.thesis: Automotive and data-center diversification are real, but handset weakness and Apple modem revenue rolling off faster than expected drove a soft guide.

signals.name: auto_record
signals.rationale: Fiscal Q3 revenue of about $9.9B beat estimates and automotive revenue rose 61% to a record $1.59B.

signals.name: weak_q4_guide
signals.rationale: Q4 EPS was guided to $2.05-2.25 versus $2.36 consensus, with handset revenue down about 20%.

signals.name: apple_modem_rolloff
signals.rationale: Qualcomm said Apple modem revenue is declining faster than previously expected as Apple ships its in-house modems.

signals.name: datacenter_target
signals.rationale: Management targets about $5B of data-center revenue by FY27, an unproven but potentially large new market.

theses.name: Palo Alto Networks
theses.thesis: Platformization is driving fast NGS ARR and RPO growth, but the FY27 guide implies NGS ARR growth decelerating sharply from 63% to the low 20s, which reset the stock lower.

signals.name: fq4_beat_arr
signals.rationale: FQ4 FY26 revenue rose 34% to $3.41B, NGS ARR grew 63% to $9.1B and RPO reached $21.2B; EPS of $1.02 beat $0.98 and FY27 revenue was guided to $14.1-14.2B.

signals.name: arr_decel_guide
signals.rationale: FY27 NGS ARR growth was guided to 22-23% versus 63% in FY26, and shares fell about 10% on Sept 2 despite the beat.

signals.name: rpo_visibility
signals.rationale: A $21.2B RPO backlog gives multi-year revenue visibility as customers consolidate onto the platform.

theses.name: NXP Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Revenue is growing 19% across all end markets with a strong Q3 guide and data-center upside, but about a third of sales come from China and automotive cyclicality remains high.

signals.name: q2_broad_growth
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue rose 19% to $3.5B with automotive up 12% to $1.94B (17% excluding divested MEMS); Q3 guided to $3.75B revenue and $4.11 non-GAAP EPS.

signals.name: backlog_visibility
signals.rationale: Management cites an improving backlog, book-to-bill above one and better visibility into early 2027, with data center emerging as a new growth engine.

signals.name: china_auto_risk
signals.rationale: China is about a third of revenue, and UBS cut the stock to Neutral warning of a China auto inventory correction, alongside tariff and export-rule exposure.

theses.name: Stryker Corporation
theses.thesis: Organic growth rebounded to 9% in Q2 after a cyberattack-hit Q1, with guidance narrowed higher, but the stock is still down about 20% over the past year.

signals.name: q2_rebound
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 net sales rose 9.4% to $6.6B (9.0% organic) and adjusted EPS 17.9% to $3.69; 2026 organic growth guidance narrowed to 8.3-9.3% and adjusted EPS to $14.95-15.10.

signals.name: h2_momentum
signals.rationale: Management says it exited Q2 with regained momentum and expects a strong second half on capital-product demand and higher production.

signals.name: cyberattack_q1
signals.rationale: A March 2026 cyberattack disrupted manufacturing; Q1 adjusted EPS of $2.60 missed the $2.98 estimate on 2.6% sales growth, and Argus cut its target to $350 from $435.

theses.name: KKR & Co.
theses.thesis: Record earnings and $133B of trailing fundraising show the franchise is outgrowing peers, though insurance returns are structurally low and private-markets sentiment is fragile.

signals.name: q2_record
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 total operating earnings rose 29% to a record $1.53B and fee-related earnings 37% to $1.21B ($1.32/share).

signals.name: fundraising
signals.rationale: KKR raised $34B in the quarter and a record $133B over 12 months, passing its $300B three-year target six months early.

signals.name: insurance_roe
signals.rationale: Management says insurance ROEs are structurally low because of asset and liability pricing pressure and is allocating less capital to the segment.

theses.name: Palantir Technologies
theses.thesis: US commercial revenue is growing ~150% with guidance raised again, but the stock trades near 144x earnings and insiders have been heavy sellers.

signals.name: q2_hypergrowth
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue rose 93% to $1.935B and US commercial revenue 149% to $764M; FY2026 revenue guidance raised to $8.15B (+82%) and adjusted FCF to $4.5-4.7B.

signals.name: record_tcv
signals.rationale: Record US commercial total contract value of $2.132B (+153%), and the Army awarded a TITAN production contract.

signals.name: insider_selling
signals.rationale: CEO Karp sold about $86M of stock in late August under a preset plan and insiders sold about $117M over 90 days; shares fell over 6% on Sept 2 at ~144x earnings.

signals.name: rich_multiple
signals.rationale: At roughly 144x earnings, Palantir remains one of the most expensive large caps and is sensitive to rate spikes.

theses.name: Oracle Corporation
theses.thesis: OCI revenue is more than doubling against a $664B backlog, but Oracle is free-cash-flow negative and funding a $90-95B capex plan with $40B of new debt and equity.

signals.name: q1_fy27_oci
signals.rationale: Q1 FY2027 revenue rose 30% to $19.35B with OCI up 121% to $7.4B and non-GAAP EPS up 30% to $1.92; full-year guidance raised.

signals.name: rpo_664b
signals.rationale: Remaining performance obligations reached $664B, about 34x quarterly revenue.

signals.name: negative_fcf_dilution
signals.rationale: Free cash flow was -$5.4B on $28.5B of quarterly capex; Oracle guided FY27 capex to $90-95B, plans to raise about $40B of debt and equity, and sold $20B of stock through an at-the-market program.

theses.name: JPMorgan Chase
theses.thesis: Record Q2 profit, rising NII guidance and benign card credit, offset by a rising expense base and Dimon's warnings that elevated asset prices mean the next credit cycle could be worse than expected.

signals.name: q2_record_nii
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 net income was a record $21.2B and net interest income rose 10% to $25.6B; full-year NII guidance was raised to ~$105.5B and the card net charge-off guide lowered to ~3.2%.

signals.name: expense_creep
signals.rationale: JPMorgan raised its 2026 expense outlook by $1B to about $106B as card competition and AI investment push costs higher.

signals.name: dimon_caution
signals.rationale: Dimon warned of elevated asset prices, fiscal deficits and geopolitical risk, saying credit losses will be 'worse than people expect' if a cycle arrives.

theses.name: Globe Life
theses.thesis: Double-digit operating EPS growth and a raised outlook support buybacks now that the DOJ and SEC probes are closed, but American Income agent sales are slipping.

signals.name: q2_beat_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 net operating income rose to $3.61/share from $3.27, and full-year guidance was raised to $15.55-15.95.

signals.name: probes_closed
signals.rationale: The DOJ and SEC probes closed in 2025, removing a regulatory overhang, and higher guidance supports continued buybacks.

signals.name: ail_sales_decline
signals.rationale: American Income Life net life sales fell 2% in Q2 as reputational damage from the probes still weighs on agent recruiting.

theses.name: Jack Henry & Associates
theses.thesis: Steady bank-tech revenue growth and margin expansion for the full year, but Q4 operating income fell and fiscal 2027 guidance implies single-digit growth.

signals.name: fy26_growth
signals.rationale: Fiscal 2026 non-GAAP revenue rose 7.3% to $2.5B and adjusted operating income 11.6%, expanding the non-GAAP operating margin to 24%.

signals.name: fy27_guide
signals.rationale: Fiscal 2027 guidance calls for GAAP revenue of $2.684-2.709B, operating margin of 24.5-24.7% and EPS of $7.33-7.38.

signals.name: q4_profit_drop
signals.rationale: Q4 FY2026 GAAP operating income fell 12.2% and GAAP EPS 10.2% to $1.57; non-GAAP adjusted operating income fell 3.1%.

theses.name: Revvity
theses.thesis: Diagnostics growth of 11% drove a beat and raised EPS guidance, while Life Sciences keeps shrinking and the company is exiting its China immunodiagnostics business.

signals.name: q2_beat_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue was $730M with Diagnostics up 12% (11% organic); 2026 adjusted EPS guidance raised to $5.30-5.40 from $5.20-5.30.

signals.name: life_sciences_decline
signals.rationale: Life Sciences revenue fell to $359M from $366M (-3% organic), and total pro forma organic growth was only 3%.

signals.name: china_exit
signals.rationale: Revvity signed a definitive agreement to divest its China immunodiagnostics business by the end of 2027, shrinking its footprint in that market.

theses.name: Illinois Tool Works
theses.thesis: Record operating income and accelerating 4.5% organic growth led to a guidance raise, but growth is modest for the multiple and analysts are trimming targets.

signals.name: q2_record_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue rose 6.1% to $4.30B with organic growth of 4.5% and record operating income of $1.15B (+7.4%); FY organic growth guidance raised 1.5 points to 3.5% and GAAP EPS to $11.45 midpoint.

signals.name: h2_momentum
signals.rationale: Management expects to sustain 4.5% organic growth in the second half, led by Test & Measurement, Welding and Polymers & Fluids.

signals.name: db_target_cut
signals.rationale: Deutsche Bank cut its ITW price target to $281.

signals.name: downgrade_neutral
signals.rationale: Illinois Tool Works was downgraded to Neutral from Overweight around Oct 9, 2026, with the target cut to $270 from $350, citing decelerating short-cycle industrial demand into 2027 (per a market-news roundup; issuing firm not named in the snippet).

theses.name: Intercontinental Exchange
theses.thesis: Record open interest and steady data revenue fund heavy buybacks, but the mortgage-technology unit is still stuck in a slow housing market and the stock has lagged in 2026.

signals.name: q2_results
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 net revenue rose 5% to $2.7B with adjusted EPS of $1.90; exchanges earned a 75% adjusted operating margin on record open interest and fixed income and data services grew 8%.

signals.name: capital_return
signals.rationale: ICE returned $945M to stockholders in Q2, including $651M of buybacks.

signals.name: mortgage_slow
signals.rationale: Mortgage technology revenue grew only 5% to $557M and 2026 segment growth is guided to low-to-mid single digits as high rates curb originations; shares were down about 12% in 2026 vs a 17% index gain.

theses.name: Monolithic Power Systems
theses.thesis: AI server power demand drove 48% growth and a guide 16% above consensus, but gross margin sits at the low end of the target model and Nvidia concentration and disclosure questions linger.

signals.name: q2_ai_surge
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue rose 47.6% to $980.6M; Enterprise Data revenue rose 164% to $380.6M (38.8% of sales), and Q3 revenue was guided to ~$1.15B, about 16.5% above consensus.

signals.name: stock_reaction
signals.rationale: Shares jumped 10.5% on the Q2 beat and guide.

signals.name: margin_low_end
signals.rationale: Gross margin held near 55%, at the low end of its target model, with Q3 guided at 55.2-55.8% (vs ~58.9% in early 2025) and no timeline for improvement.

signals.name: nvidia_concentration
signals.rationale: Restatement-related investigations and allegations about Nvidia order cancellations remained live as of late July, keeping customer-concentration and disclosure risk in focus.

theses.name: NetApp
theses.thesis: AI-driven all-flash demand pushed revenue up 30% with guidance raised, but surging NAND and DRAM costs have forced a lower gross-margin outlook.

signals.name: q1_record
signals.rationale: Q1 FY2027 revenue rose 30% to a record $2.03B and non-GAAP EPS to a record $2.58; all-flash revenue rose 47% to $1.3B and FY27 revenue and EPS guidance were raised significantly.

signals.name: billings
signals.rationale: Billings rose 36% to $2.06B and public cloud revenue 28% to $206M, while the DataPelago acquisition adds AI data infrastructure.

signals.name: nand_margin
signals.rationale: NetApp guided FY2027 gross margin down to about 68.5-69.5% from ~71.3% as NAND and DRAM contract prices surged; management expects the July quarter to be the trough.

theses.name: Motorola Solutions
theses.thesis: Public-safety demand produced 13% Q2 growth, a record $15.6B backlog and a guidance raise, though memory costs and tariffs squeezed margins earlier in the year.

signals.name: q2_beat_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 sales rose 13% to $3.1B and non-GAAP EPS 24% to $4.41; 2026 revenue guidance raised to ~$12.975B and EPS to $17.62-17.72.

signals.name: record_backlog
signals.rationale: Record Q2 backlog of $15.6B (+11%) on record orders, plus a $1.5B deal to acquire counter-drone maker D-Fend Solutions.

signals.name: q1_margin_squeeze
signals.rationale: Q1 2026 operating margin fell to 19.3% from 23% and shares dropped about 10%, with management flagging memory component costs expected to more than double in 2026 plus tariff exposure.

theses.name: Nvidia
theses.thesis: Data-center revenue more than doubled to $89B a quarter with another ~12% sequential step guided, but gross margin is edging down and China data-center sales are excluded from guidance.

signals.name: q2_fy27_beat
signals.rationale: Q2 FY2027 revenue was $96.2B (+106% y/y, +18% q/q) with data-center revenue of $89.0B (+117%) and a 75.0% gross margin.

signals.name: q3_guide
signals.rationale: Q3 FY2027 revenue guided to $108.0B (+/-2%), above the ~$91-92B pace the Street had penciled in before the report.

signals.name: margin_china
signals.rationale: Q3 gross margin was guided to 74.0% (+/-50bp), down from 75.0%, and guidance assumes no China data-center compute revenue.

theses.name: Interactive Brokers
theses.thesis: Account growth above 30% and a 77% pretax margin drive record revenue, but about half of revenue is net interest income that shrinks with each Fed cut.

signals.name: q2_record
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 net revenue reached $1.90B with diluted EPS of $0.69 (vs $0.51); accounts rose 34% to 5.19M, client equity 40% to $930B and commissions 30% to $673M, at a 77% pretax margin.

signals.name: dart_growth
signals.rationale: Daily average revenue trades rose 36% to 4.82 million, showing sustained trading engagement.

signals.name: rate_sensitivity
signals.rationale: The CFO says each 25bp Fed cut reduces annual net interest income by about $82M, and net interest margin has already compressed to 1.93% from 2.07%.

theses.name: Huntington Bancshares
theses.thesis: The Cadence and Veritex acquisitions lifted net interest income 40%, with integrations finished and 2027 targets reaffirmed, but merger charges keep GAAP EPS below last year's.

signals.name: nii_growth
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 net interest income rose 9% sequentially and 40% year over year; average loans rose 42% to $189.3B including the Cadence and Veritex deals.

signals.name: integration_done
signals.rationale: The Cadence systems conversion was completed in mid-June; management reaffirmed 2027 targets of 18-19% ROTCE and $1.90-1.93 EPS.

signals.name: merger_charges
signals.rationale: GAAP EPS of $0.33 was $0.01 below the year-ago quarter because of merger-related notable items (adjusted EPS $0.39).

theses.name: Hartford Insurance Group
theses.thesis: Commercial underwriting and a 22% jump in investment income produced an ~19% core ROE, while personal-lines premiums are shrinking and catastrophe losses remain lumpy.

signals.name: q2_core_earnings
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 core earnings were $945M ($3.42/share) with an 18.7% trailing core ROE; Business Insurance premiums rose 5% at an 89.3 underlying combined ratio and net investment income rose 22% to $800M.

signals.name: personal_shrink
signals.rationale: Personal Insurance written premiums fell 7%, and catastrophe losses rose to $222M from $212M on tornado, wind and hail events.

signals.name: buybacks
signals.rationale: Strong capital generation supports ongoing share repurchases.

theses.name: Huntington Ingalls Industries
theses.thesis: Shipyard throughput is finally improving, with guidance raised and a $54B backlog, but shipbuilding margins are still thin and labor shortages keep delaying Navy deliveries.

signals.name: q2_guide_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue rose 10.9% to $3.4B and EPS was $5.27; 2026 shipbuilding revenue guidance was raised to $10.2-10.4B (from $9.7-9.9B) and margin guidance to 6-6.5%, with $6.7B of awards lifting backlog to $54B.

signals.name: throughput_gains
signals.rationale: Shipbuilding throughput improved 12% year to date toward a 15% full-year target.

signals.name: labor_delays
signals.rationale: Pentagon budget documents cite HII's persistent shipyard labor shortage for delays to the next two big-deck amphibious ships, with USS Bougainville pushed from December 2025 to August 2026.

theses.name: Howmet Aerospace
theses.thesis: Engine-parts and gas-turbine demand drove 24% revenue growth and a guidance raise, but the stock trades near 65x earnings and GE's purchase of a rival casting supplier threatens its pricing power.

signals.name: q2_beat_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue rose 24% (21% organic) to $2.55B and adjusted EPS 46% to $1.33; Engine Products revenue rose 32% with a 37.7% EBITDA margin, and 2026 guidance was raised to $10.0-10.1B revenue and $5.23-5.27 EPS.

signals.name: gas_turbine_demand
signals.rationale: Gas-turbine revenue grew 38%, which management calls extraordinary demand tied to power generation build-outs.

signals.name: ge_casting_rival
signals.rationale: Shares dropped nearly 11% after GE bought a rival casting supplier, raising the risk of lost pricing power and program share.

signals.name: rich_multiple
signals.rationale: At about 65x earnings vs ~38x for the aerospace and defense industry, the multiple leaves little room for error.

theses.name: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals
theses.thesis: Dupixent and Eylea HD set records and Q2 EPS beat by more than 40%, but the original Eylea franchise is eroding fast under biosimilar competition.

signals.name: q2_beat
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue rose 17% to $4.3B and non-GAAP EPS of $14.29 beat the $10.00 consensus; Dupixent global sales rose 38% to $6.0B and Eylea HD US sales 52% to $596M.

signals.name: eylea_erosion
signals.rationale: Original Eylea US sales fell 45% and the combined US Eylea franchise fell 12% to $1.01B; Regeneron expects further declines in the second half as more biosimilars launch.

signals.name: sandoz_biosimilar
signals.rationale: A settlement lets Sandoz launch its Eylea biosimilar by the end of 2026.

signals.name: sanofi_balance_repaid
signals.rationale: Regeneron fully repaid its Sanofi development balance, so it now records its full share of Dupixent collaboration profits.

theses.name: Pfizer
theses.thesis: Non-COVID growth (Eliquis, Padcev) beat Q2 estimates and Metsera adds an obesity pipeline, but the steepest patent cliff in large-cap pharma, led by Eliquis generics in 2028, hangs over earnings.

signals.name: q2_beat
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue of $15.03B beat $14.40B estimates and adjusted EPS of $0.77 beat $0.68; Eliquis rose 19% operationally and 2026 revenue guidance was raised $500M at the midpoint.

signals.name: covid_cut
signals.rationale: Pfizer cut its 2026 COVID-product revenue forecast to $4B from $5B and kept adjusted EPS guidance at $2.80-3.00 as Comirnaty and Paxlovid demand fades.

signals.name: loe_cliff
signals.rationale: Generic Eliquis can launch from April 2028 under settlements and Ibrance loses US exclusivity in 2027; loss-of-exclusivity headwinds are estimated at about $1.5B in 2026 alone.

signals.name: metsera_obesity
signals.rationale: Pfizer plans about ten pivotal trials in 2026 for Metsera's monthly obesity injections, targeting first approval in 2028.

theses.name: Microchip Technology
theses.thesis: The inventory correction is over and revenue is up ~38% from the trough with ~40% growth guided, while leverage and a dividend that exceeded FY26 earnings limit flexibility.

signals.name: q1_recovery
signals.rationale: Q1 FY2027 net sales rose 38% year over year (13.2% sequentially) to $1.485B with non-GAAP EPS of $0.76; September-quarter sales guided up 7-9% sequentially (~41% year over year).

signals.name: inventory_done
signals.rationale: Inventory days fell to 175 from 185 and distribution inventory to 25 days; management says the distribution inventory correction is complete.

signals.name: leverage_dividend
signals.rationale: The dividend exceeded 100% of FY2026 earnings and high leverage still limits buybacks and acquisitions until debt falls further.

theses.name: Marvell Technology
theses.thesis: Data-center revenue is accelerating on custom AI silicon and optics, with FY27/FY28 targets raised to ~$12B/~$18B, but the custom mix is diluting gross margin.

signals.name: q2_record
signals.rationale: Q2 FY2027 revenue rose 37% to a record $2.739B with data-center revenue up 46%; non-GAAP EPS was $0.94.

signals.name: targets_raised
signals.rationale: Marvell raised its FY2027 revenue outlook to about $12B and set a FY2028 target near $18B on a custom-silicon acceleration.

signals.name: margin_dilution
signals.rationale: Q3 non-GAAP gross margin was guided to 57.5-58.5%, about 90bp lower sequentially at the midpoint, as lower-margin custom AI silicon grows; shares fell about 8% after the report.

theses.name: Micron Technology
theses.thesis: An AI-driven memory shortage has produced record revenue and ~86% gross margins, but memory is cyclical and the market keeps discounting peak-pricing risk.

signals.name: fq4_record
signals.rationale: Fiscal Q4 2026 revenue was $54.23B vs $41.46B the prior quarter and $11.32B a year earlier, with GAAP net income of $37.70B ($32.87/share).

signals.name: hbm_ramp
signals.rationale: HBM revenue grew about 30% sequentially toward an ~$8B annual run rate, with HBM4 supply reported sold out for 2026.

signals.name: peak_pricing_fears
signals.rationale: After record FQ3 results in July, shares slid 10.6% in a week on worries that memory pricing is near a cyclical peak, and they dipped again after FQ4.

theses.name: Microsoft
theses.thesis: Azure growth reaccelerated to 43% and crossed $100B a year, but capex is heading toward $255-260B in FY27 and OpenAI makes up a large share of the cloud backlog.

signals.name: fy26_q4_azure
signals.rationale: Fiscal Q4 2026 revenue rose 18% to $90.0B; Azure grew 43% and passed $100B in annual revenue, with 45% constant-currency growth guided for the September quarter vs ~41% consensus.

signals.name: copilot_seats
signals.rationale: Microsoft 365 Copilot passed 30 million paid seats.

signals.name: capex_surge
signals.rationale: Quarterly capex including finance leases rose 69% to $41B, and the FY2027 capex guide is $255-260B, raising return-on-investment questions.

signals.name: openai_concentration
signals.rationale: Microsoft disclosed in January that OpenAI accounts for about 45% of its cloud backlog; the stock fell 12% intraday as investors questioned AI spending returns and concentration risk.

theses.name: Generac
theses.thesis: Data-center backup power is becoming a second growth engine ($1.6B backlog, hyperscaler contracts), offsetting a shrinking residential business, though margins are flattered by one-time tariff refunds.

signals.name: data_center_ramp
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 net sales rose 11% to $1.17B with C&I up 29% on more than $100M of data-center revenue; data-center backlog reached about $1.6B, including a nearly $700M hyperscaler commitment for 2027.

signals.name: residential_decline
signals.rationale: Residential sales fell 2% to $621M, the company's largest segment.

signals.name: tariff_refund_margin
signals.rationale: Adjusted EBITDA margin guidance was raised to 20-21%, but about 1.5 points of that comes from one-time tariff refunds.

theses.name: Global Payments
theses.thesis: Now a pure-play merchant processor after the Worldpay swap, with 42% operating margins, 12% adjusted EPS growth and heavy buybacks, but growth is only mid-single-digit and GAAP earnings are buried under integration charges.

signals.name: q2_adj_growth
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 adjusted EPS rose 12% to $3.46 on $3.16B adjusted net revenue; 2026 adjusted EPS guided to $13.60-$13.80 with a 150bp margin-expansion target.

signals.name: buybacks
signals.rationale: Repurchased $550M of shares in Q2 and returned $1.2B to shareholders year-to-date.

signals.name: gaap_charges_slow_growth
signals.rationale: GAAP diluted EPS was only $0.05 on Worldpay-related charges, and 2026 constant-currency revenue growth is guided to just 4-5%.

theses.name: Moderna
theses.thesis: The first Phase 3 cancer-vaccine win (intismeran with Keytruda in melanoma) remade the story and sent shares up about 350% in 2026, but revenue is still tiny, losses run near $800M a quarter, and other pipeline bets have failed.

signals.name: melanoma_ph3
signals.rationale: Intismeran autogene plus Keytruda beat Keytruda alone at preventing melanoma recurrence in a ~1,100-patient Phase 3, the first Phase 3 success for a cancer vaccine; shares surged more than 90%.

signals.name: norovirus_fail
signals.rationale: Norovirus vaccine mRNA-1403 failed to meet interim efficacy criteria in Phase 3, removing a pipeline asset investors had valued.

signals.name: losses_continue
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue was just $145M (beat $103M estimates) while the net loss was $782M ($1.97/share), with only up to 10% revenue growth guided for 2026.

signals.name: wolfe_upgrade
signals.rationale: Wolfe Research upgraded the stock on the positive trial data.

theses.name: Wynn Resorts
theses.thesis: Q2 earnings doubled on Macau strength and record Las Vegas months, and the UAE resort opens in 2027, yet the stock sits at a 52-week low on consumer-spending and leverage worries.

signals.name: q2_strong
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 operating revenue rose to $1.86B and diluted EPS to $1.32 from $0.64; Macau revenue topped $1B (+13.7%) and Las Vegas set a monthly EBITDAR record in May.

signals.name: uae_pipeline
signals.rationale: Wynn Al Marjan Island in the UAE is scheduled to open in September 2027, the company's first new integrated resort in over a decade.

signals.name: new_debt
signals.rationale: Wynn priced $900M of new notes as the stock traded near its 52-week low, adding to an already heavy debt load.

signals.name: 52wk_low
signals.rationale: Shares fell 1.84% to $75.88 on Oct 2, near the 52-week low ($75.75-$134.72), as falling consumer confidence and Macau growth questions weighed on gaming stocks.

theses.name: Labcorp
theses.thesis: Steady diagnostics growth and buybacks support raised guidance, while Medicare lab fee cuts and a soft central-lab business cap upside.

signals.name: q2_beat_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue rose 5.8% to $3.73B and adjusted EPS 14.9% to $4.99; full-year adjusted EPS guidance raised to $18.10-$18.55.

signals.name: buyback
signals.rationale: Board added $1.0B to the repurchase authorization (now $1.4B) after buying back $353.8M of stock in the quarter.

signals.name: pama_cuts
signals.rationale: CMS set preliminary cuts to Medicare clinical lab reimbursement rates; Labcorp has estimated about a $100M top- and bottom-line hit if PAMA cuts proceed, only about $25M of which it expects to offset.

theses.name: Keysight Technologies
theses.thesis: AI data-center and 6G test demand drove record orders and ~37% revenue growth, but the stock trades near 58x earnings, leaving little room for a capex pause.

signals.name: q3_record_orders
signals.rationale: Fiscal Q3 2026 orders rose 56% to a record $2.09B and revenue 37% to $1.846B; non-GAAP EPS was $3.07 vs $1.72, and Q4 guidance is $1.93-1.95B revenue and $3.34-3.40 EPS.

signals.name: fy_outlook
signals.rationale: Management expects fiscal 2026 revenue growth of about 32% and EPS growth of about 60%, with Commercial Communications revenue up 56% to over $1B at a 34% segment margin.

signals.name: rich_valuation
signals.rationale: Shares trade around 58x earnings versus a ~33x electronics-industry average, leaving elevated downside if test and capex budgets cool.

theses.name: General Dynamics
theses.thesis: Record $136.5B backlog on Gulfstream and submarine demand supports raised guidance, but fixed-price shipbuilding leaves margins exposed and the stock slid through September.

signals.name: q2_beat_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue rose 8.1% to $14.1B and EPS 13.4% to $4.24; backlog hit a record $136.5B (+32%) on a 1.4x book-to-bill, and 2026 EPS guidance was raised to $16.80-$16.90.

signals.name: gulfstream_demand
signals.rationale: Aerospace book-to-bill was 1.5x, its strongest first half for orders since 2022, with about 160 Gulfstream deliveries expected in 2026.

signals.name: shipbuilding_execution
signals.rationale: Analysts caution that naval shipbuilding runs on fixed-price contracts exposed to cost overruns, so recent Marine Systems margin gains may not be durable.

theses.name: KLA Corporation
theses.thesis: Process-control leader posting record revenue on AI and advanced-packaging demand (post 10-for-1 split), with US export rules on China customers the main structural headwind.

signals.name: fy26_record
signals.rationale: Fiscal Q4 2026 revenue reached a record $3.66B with GAAP EPS of $1.04 at the top of guidance; fiscal 2026 revenue was $13.58B with GAAP net income of $4.83B.

signals.name: guide_higher
signals.rationale: Management's September-quarter guide points to further sequential growth on AI-driven process-control demand.

signals.name: china_export_rules
signals.rationale: KLA's 10-Q says Commerce Department rules restrict selling certain products and services to some China customers, and warns additional restrictions could disrupt shipments and revenue in its largest region.

theses.name: Lam Research
theses.thesis: AI-driven etch and deposition demand produced record margins and a guide 14% above consensus, while China, once over a third of sales, is shrinking under export controls.

signals.name: q4_record_guide
signals.rationale: June-quarter revenue of $6.72B and non-GAAP EPS of $1.82 beat estimates with a 20-year-high 52.0% gross margin; September-quarter guidance of $8.1B revenue and $2.15 EPS was about 14-18% above consensus.

signals.name: wfe_outlook_raised
signals.rationale: CEO raised the 2026 wafer-fab-equipment outlook to the low-$150B range from about $140B.

signals.name: china_shrinking
signals.rationale: China fell to 26% of revenue from 34% the prior quarter as domestic customer spending declined under export restrictions.

theses.name: Goldman Sachs Group
theses.thesis: Record equities trading and a dealmaking recovery drove a 39% revenue jump, but results are highly market-sensitive and private-credit stress is showing up in Goldman's own BDC.

signals.name: q2_record
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 net revenue rose 39% to $20.34B and net earnings to $6.63B; equities revenue hit a record $7.42B (+72%) and investment-banking fees rose 55% to about $3.4B.

signals.name: ma_pipeline
signals.rationale: Goldman advised on about $1.2 trillion of announced M&A in the first half of 2026, a record pace, and management says clients are bringing their most critical deals to the firm.

signals.name: private_credit_stress
signals.rationale: Lenders cut commitments to Goldman Sachs BDC in May 2026 and added a liability-management blocker; the fund has seen rising non-accruals and a Fitch outlook downgrade.

theses.name: Merck & Co.
theses.thesis: Keytruda keeps growing and the subcutaneous version is shifting patients ahead of 2028 patent expiry, but Gardasil is shrinking fast on China weakness.

signals.name: q2_beat_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue rose 5% to $16.61B vs $16.36B expected; Keytruda grew 5% to $8.37B and full-year revenue guidance was raised.

signals.name: keytruda_qlex
signals.rationale: Subcutaneous Keytruda QLEX contributed $463M and is already a double-digit share of US Keytruda; the CFO targets 30-40% adoption by end-2027, cushioning the 2028 loss of exclusivity.

signals.name: gardasil_decline
signals.rationale: Gardasil sales fell 22% to $1.07B in Q1 2026 on weak China demand and elevated inventory at partner Zhifei; China revenue is expected to be immaterial in 2026.

theses.name: GE Vernova
theses.thesis: AI-driven power demand pushed Q2 orders up 88% and backlog to a record $176B with guidance raised, while wind remains a deepening loss-maker and a short seller argues the gas-turbine cycle is priced as permanent growth.

signals.name: q2_orders_backlog
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 orders rose 88% organically to $24.2B and backlog reached a record $176.3B (+$13B sequentially); 2026 revenue guidance raised to $45.5-46.5B and FCF to $11.5-12.5B.

signals.name: wind_losses
signals.rationale: Wind orders fell 40% and segment EBITDA loss widened to $275M from $165M; the company guides to a roughly $400M wind EBITDA loss for 2026.

signals.name: glj_sell
signals.rationale: GLJ Research initiated at Sell with a $470 target on Sept 14, arguing the cyclical gas-turbine business is priced as hypergrowth; shares fell over 8% that day.

signals.name: targets_rising
signals.rationale: Consensus price target rose to $1,237 as Street targets climbed every quarter of 2026.

theses.name: Eli Lilly and Company
theses.thesis: Incretin volume growth is overwhelming price erosion, with Q2 revenue up 48% and guidance raised again; the risk is that steep GLP-1 price declines and competition compress the growth rate priced into a $1T valuation.

signals.name: q2_beat_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue rose 48% to $23.0B (Mounjaro +91% to $9.9B, Zepbound +46% to $4.9B); 2026 revenue guidance raised to $85-87B.

signals.name: price_erosion
signals.rationale: Mounjaro and Zepbound generated $14.87B in Q2, with volume growth offsetting a 13% realized price decline as GLP-1 pricing resets under Medicare deals and cash-pay competition.

signals.name: pipeline_retatrutide
signals.rationale: Three more positive Phase 3 retatrutide obesity trials completed the data package; Lilly plans an FDA submission in Q1 2027, and oral Foundayo (orforglipron) added $98M in its first partial quarter.

theses.name: IBM
theses.thesis: Enterprise customers are diverting budgets from software and mainframes to AI hardware, which drove a Q2 miss and a guidance cut; the Confluent deal and hybrid-cloud strategy are the recovery case.

signals.name: q2_miss_guide_cut
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue of $17.16B missed $17.58B estimates; 2026 revenue growth guidance cut to 4-5% from above 5%, with IBM Z mainframe revenue down 42%. The July 14 preliminary warning sent shares down 25%, the steepest one-day fall in over a century.

signals.name: confluent_closed
signals.rationale: IBM completed its $11B all-cash acquisition of data-streaming platform Confluent on March 17, 2026, adding real-time data infrastructure for AI workloads.

signals.name: continued_weakness
signals.rationale: Shares fell another 1.4% to about $222.55 on Oct 2 amid continuing concern over IBM Z performance.

theses.name: Tesla, Inc.
theses.thesis: Deliveries are setting records again and beat Q3 estimates, but automotive profitability has collapsed (1.4% operating margin in Q2) as price cuts and AI spending outrun volume, leaving the valuation dependent on robotaxi and Optimus delivery.

signals.name: q3_delivery_beat
signals.rationale: Q3 2026 deliveries of 486,532 beat the ~462K company-compiled consensus, following a record 480,126 in Q2.

signals.name: q2_margin_collapse
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 adjusted EPS of $0.33 missed the $0.54 consensus by 38%; operating income was $398M vs $1.5B expected (1.4% margin) and gross margin was 16.8% vs 19.5% expected, on lower ASPs, fewer regulatory credits and higher AI/R&D spend.

signals.name: delivery_rally
signals.rationale: Shares rose 4.65% to $370.59 on Oct 2 on volume about 39% above average after the delivery beat.

theses.name: Jabil
theses.thesis: AI data-center build-outs are driving 20%+ growth in Intelligent Infrastructure and a strong fiscal 2026 finish, though the stock remains well below earlier analyst targets and non-AI segments are soft.

signals.name: q4_fy26_beat
signals.rationale: Q4 FY26 revenue was $10.6B with core EPS of $4.40, exceeding company expectations; FY26 revenue grew 21% to $36.0B with core EPS of $13.09 and more than $1.5B of adjusted FCF. Q1 FY27 revenue guided to $10.6-$11.4B.

signals.name: ai_infrastructure
signals.rationale: Q3 Intelligent Infrastructure revenue rose 21% to $4.2B, with networking and communications up more than 50%.

signals.name: goldman_target_cut
signals.rationale: Goldman Sachs kept Buy but cut its target to $375 from $482 on Sept 8.

signals.name: non_ai_softness
signals.rationale: Analysts flag that Jabil's AI growth is offsetting weakness in other segments.

theses.name: Fiserv
theses.thesis: A new CEO is resetting targets after a guidance cut, with Argentina, delayed client implementations and slower Clover growth weighing; the stock sits near 52-week lows at a low multiple.

signals.name: q2_miss_guide_cut
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 adjusted EPS of $1.84 missed $1.89-$1.92 estimates and adjusted revenue fell 4%; 2026 organic growth guidance cut to -1% to flat (from +1-3%) and adjusted EPS to $7.20-$7.40 (from $8.00-$8.30). Shares fell about 11% premarket.

signals.name: target_cuts
signals.rationale: Goldman Sachs and RBC both cut price targets after the reset.

signals.name: argentina_driven
signals.rationale: Analysis argues the guidance cut reflects Argentina macro volatility more than core-business deterioration, leaving room for recovery off a depressed base.

theses.name: McKesson Corporation
theses.thesis: Oncology, specialty and GLP-1 volumes keep compounding EPS at mid-teens rates with heavy buybacks, but the stock trades near consensus targets and depends on high-priced drug volumes that face pricing policy risk.

signals.name: q1_fy27_raise

signals.name: capital_return
signals.rationale: Board raised the quarterly dividend 15% to $0.94 and the company returned $2.6B in the quarter, including a $2.25B accelerated buyback.

signals.name: rbc_sector_perform
signals.rationale: RBC initiated at Sector Perform with an $845 target, and the consensus target of about $877 sits below the recent price, leaving little modeled upside.

theses.name: Medtronic
theses.thesis: Cardiovascular-led growth produced a Q1 FY27 beat-and-raise and Hugo robotics keeps expanding, but the quarter was flattered by an extra week and the stock has drifted lower since the report.

signals.name: q1_fy27_beat_raise
signals.rationale: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 13.7% to $9.8B (about 200bp above guidance) with Cardiovascular up 19.5%; FY27 organic growth guidance raised to 7.25-7.75% and non-GAAP EPS to $5.94-$6.00.

signals.name: hugo_robotics
signals.rationale: FDA cleared the LigaSure RAS Maryland Jaw for the Hugo surgical robot on Sept 16, and Medtronic committed $700M to robotics alongside the Q1 report.

signals.name: extra_week_flatter
signals.rationale: The extra fiscal week in Q1 FY27 added about $570M to organic revenue, so underlying growth was well below the headline 13.7%.

signals.name: post_report_drift
signals.rationale: Shares slid from $93.10 on Sept 3 to $88.29 on Sept 28 despite the raised outlook.

theses.name: Intel
theses.thesis: AI-driven CPU demand and early external foundry wins (Apple preliminary deal, Tesla on 14A) support the turnaround, but the foundry still loses about $2B a quarter on tiny external revenue while capex climbs past $20B.

signals.name: q2_ai_beat
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 revenue of $16.1B was a seventh straight quarterly beat, with AI-related demand driving most of the business and 18A volume running ahead of target.

signals.name: foundry_losses
signals.rationale: Intel Foundry lost $2.1B on $5.8B of Q2 sales (tenth straight loss, $28B since Q1 2024); external customers were only $293M, about 5% of segment revenue, and 2026 capex was raised to over $20B. Shares fell about 8% on the report.

signals.name: apple_foundry_deal
signals.rationale: Intel reached a preliminary agreement to manufacture some Apple chips after more than a year of talks, a marquee external foundry validation (first chips roughly 18 months out).

signals.name: rate_selloff
signals.rationale: Shares fell 5.67% to $116.03 on Sept 28 as chip stocks led a tech decline and the 10-year Treasury yield hit its highest since 2007, after a run from $89 to $123 in September.

theses.name: Ulta Beauty, Inc.

signals.name: buyback_raise
signals.rationale: Raised the fiscal 2026 buyback plan to $1.8B from $1.5B.

signals.name: muted_reaction
signals.rationale: The stock's reaction to the beat-and-raise was muted, suggesting the improvement is largely priced in.

theses.name: WEC Energy Group, Inc.

signals.name: eps_growth
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 EPS rose $0.15 to $0.91 and 2026 guidance of $5.51-$5.61 was reaffirmed.

signals.name: capex_financing
signals.rationale: Shares fell premarket after the beat as investors weighed the financing needs of the $37.5B plan, with new gas generation not online until late 2027.

theses.name: Weyerhaeuser Company

signals.name: new_lows
signals.rationale: Shares closed at $18.59 on Oct 1, a fresh 52-week low, down about 21% over the past year.

theses.name: HP Inc.

signals.name: weak_q4
signals.rationale: The CFO expects below-seasonal Q4 revenue and Personal Systems margins at their fiscal-year low before improving in 2027.

theses.name: GE Aerospace

signals.name: supply_delays

theses.name: Johnson & Johnson

signals.name: q2_beat_raise
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 sales rose 6.6% to $25.3B and adjusted EPS of $2.90 beat $2.84; 2026 guidance raised to $100.6B sales and $11.50-$11.65 EPS.

signals.name: tremfya_growth
signals.rationale: Tremfya grew 71% on its IBD launch; ex-Stelara growth was double digits.

signals.name: stelara_erosion
signals.rationale: Stelara sales fell 55.7% on biosimilar competition, cutting about 4.6 points from worldwide operational growth.

theses.name: Fifth Third Bancorp

signals.rationale: Q2 2026 net interest income rose 48% to $2.22B after closing the $12.7B Comerica deal; adjusted EPS $1.02, adjusted ROTCE 19%.

signals.name: merger_charges

theses.name: Tractor Supply Company

signals.rationale: Q2 2026 comparable sales fell 1.5% on 1.7% fewer transactions, missing estimates; full-year guidance cut to comps of -1% to flat and EPS of $1.90-$2.00.

signals.name: petsense_closures
signals.rationale: Will close 75 Petsense stores after a weak May.

signals.name: sales_growth
signals.rationale: Net sales still grew 2.3% to $4.54B from new stores, and comps were positive in April and June.

theses.name: Vistra Corp.

signals.rationale: Signed 20-year nuclear PPAs with Meta (2,600 MW) and AWS (1,200 MW), and FERC approved the ~5,500 MW Cogentrix gas fleet acquisition.

signals.name: ebitda_growth
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 adjusted EBITDA rose 30%+ to $1.77B; 2026 EBITDA guidance of $6.8B-$7.6B reaffirmed.

signals.rationale: Q2 GAAP net income of $305M absorbed a $472M unrealized hedge loss, and shares are down about 30% over 12 months near the low end of a $132.66-$217.10 range.

signals.name: doe_nuclear_loan
signals.rationale: The US Energy Department announced a $4.2B conditional loan commitment for upgrades at Vistra's Pennsylvania and Ohio nuclear plants in early October 2026; shares rose about 11% on the news.

theses.name: Welltower Inc.
theses.thesis: Senior-housing NOI has grown 20%+ for 15 straight quarters and FFO is up 25% with guidance raised, but the stock trades at a very rich multiple.

signals.name: guidance_raise
signals.rationale: Raised 2026 normalized FFO guidance to $6.36-$6.44 from $6.21-$6.35.

signals.name: rich_valuation
signals.rationale: Trades at roughly 100x trailing earnings and about 36x FFO guidance, with a 1.5% dividend yield against 5%+ Treasuries.

theses.name: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company
theses.thesis: Record AI and networking demand drove 34% revenue growth and a raised outlook, but management expects gross margins to normalize as lower-margin AI systems grow and memory stays tight.

signals.rationale: Fiscal Q3 2026 revenue rose 34% to $12.2B with non-GAAP EPS of $1.11; AI systems orders rose 30%+ sequentially to $2.4B and networking orders 36%.

signals.name: outlook_raise
signals.rationale: Guides FY26 revenue growth of 34-37% and FY27 13-17%; won a $1.2B Vultr order for AMD Helios racks, sending the stock to a record $63.89 on Sept 30.

signals.name: margin_normalization
signals.rationale: The CFO expects gross margin to fall from the record 40% toward historical levels as lower-margin AI systems grow, with DDR5 and NAND shortages constraining supply.

theses.name: Fortive Corporation

signals.rationale: Q2 2026 core revenue grew 6.7% and adjusted EPS 28% to $0.74; full-year adjusted EPS guidance raised to $2.95-$3.05 and core growth to ~4% from 2-3%.

signals.name: buybacks
signals.rationale: Repurchased ~$2B of stock over four quarters, about 11% of shares outstanding.

signals.name: healthcare_emea_soft

theses.name: IQVIA Holdings Inc.

signals.name: guidance_raise
signals.rationale: Raised 2026 guidance, including adjusted EPS of $12.80-$13.00 (+7.4-9.1%).

signals.name: valuation
signals.rationale: After rising from a $154.50 low toward $277, shares trade about 4.5% above GuruFocus's fair-value estimate and fell 3% on Oct 1.

theses.name: Fidelity National Information Services, Inc.

signals.name: buyback_pause
signals.rationale: Management temporarily paused share buybacks and tuck-in acquisitions to preserve flexibility.

theses.name: The TJX Companies, Inc.
theses.thesis: Off-price share gains and margin expansion led to another guidance raise, though the core Marmaxx division comped just 1% and second-half comps are guided to slow.

signals.rationale: Marmaxx, its largest US division, comped only +1%, and Q3/Q4 comps are guided to just 2-3%.

signals.rationale: Reported EPS of $1.36 included a $0.14 one-time tariff-refund benefit.

signals.name: guidance_raise
signals.rationale: Raised full-year FY27 pretax profit margin and EPS guidance after Q2 pretax margin and EPS came in well above plan; full-year comp guidance is 3-4%.

theses.name: Southern Company

signals.name: revenue_miss_equity

theses.name: VICI Properties Inc.

signals.name: at_52w_low

theses.name: Public Service Enterprise Group Incorporated

signals.name: nuclear_output
signals.rationale: The nuclear fleet produced 7.8 TWh at a 92% capacity factor in Q2.

signals.name: near_low

theses.name: Ventas, Inc.

theses.name: Gen Digital Inc.

theses.name: Incyte Corporation

signals.name: jakafi_price
signals.rationale: Jakafi's growth was volume-driven with a $13.4M price decrease, and it remains over half of sales ahead of its patent expiry later this decade.

theses.name: Starbucks Corporation
theses.thesis: The Back to Starbucks turnaround is working, with ~8% comps led by transactions and guidance raised, but revenue is shrinking after the China deal and store closures.

signals.name: revenue_decline
signals.rationale: Consolidated revenue fell 1% to $9.3B, reflecting the Starbucks China transaction, and non-GAAP EPS was $0.85.

signals.name: closures_drag
signals.rationale: Store closures under the restructuring are cutting unit growth.

theses.name: IDEXX Laboratories, Inc.

signals.name: vet_visits_decline
signals.rationale: US clinical wellness visits fell 3.4% in Q2, the key volume headwind for its diagnostics franchise.

signals.name: near_lows
signals.rationale: At $519.26 the stock is about 33% below its 52-week high, near its $500.61 low.

theses.name: Royal Caribbean Cruises Ltd.
theses.thesis: Yields beat and EPS guidance rose 14%, but the stock is down about a quarter from its high on Europe softness and a weaker cruise sector.

signals.name: q2_beat_raise

signals.name: europe_headwind
signals.rationale: Management cited modest Europe yield headwinds from geopolitical events; Q2 EPS of $4.20 was below $4.41 a year earlier.

signals.name: bofa_upgrade
signals.rationale: BofA upgraded RCL to Buy after a roughly 26% slide from its high.

theses.name: PPL Corporation

signals.name: guidance_reaffirmed

signals.name: q2_miss
signals.rationale: Q2 2026 ongoing EPS of $0.33 missed the $0.37 consensus and revenue of $2.11B missed $2.19B, with IT transformation costs weighing.

theses.name: UDR, Inc.

signals.name: rate_headwind

theses.name: Gartner, Inc.

signals.name: cv_stall
signals.rationale: FX-neutral contract value grew just 1.7% to $5.3B and adjusted revenue 1.8%, after decelerating from 8% at end-2024.

signals.name: buybacks

signals.name: ai_substitution
signals.rationale: Analysts flag AI research tools as substituting for Gartner subscriptions and analyst inquiries, with renewals also hit by government cost cuts.

theses.name: Humana Inc.

signals.name: barclays_target_raise
signals.rationale: Barclays raised its price target and the shares rose 4.7% to $398.13 on Sept 25.

theses.name: Ross Stores, Inc.

theses.name: Pinnacle West Capital Corporation

signals.name: q2_eps_decline

signals.name: rate_case_risk

theses.name: Simon Property Group, Inc.

signals.rationale: Raised 2026 Real Estate FFO guidance to $13.20-$13.30 from $13.10-$13.25.

signals.name: headline_ffo_dip

theses.name: Fortinet, Inc.

signals.rationale: Operating margin held at 21.0% as SG&A fell to 23.5% of sales from 24.4%.

theses.name: Erie Indemnity Company

signals.rationale: The data-center load pipeline more than doubled in three months, supporting its $73B capital plan.

signals.name: mizuho_downgrade
signals.rationale: Mizuho cut PG&E to Neutral from Outperform and its target to $16 from $21 after the wildfire bill omitted investor protections.

signals.name: target_cuts

signals.rationale: Reaffirmed 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance of $2.4B-$2.6B on healthy public construction and large projects.

signals.name: energy_cost_squeeze
signals.rationale: Unit cash cost of sales rose 7% (vs 5% pricing) on almost $40M of energy headwinds, mainly diesel; shipments grew just 1% with rain hitting Texas and the Southeast.

theses.name: Flex Ltd.

signals.name: customer_concentration

theses.name: Expeditors International of Washington, Inc.

signals.rationale: Elevated air buy/sell rates reflected belly capacity lost to the Middle East conflict; as passenger capacity returns, part of the earnings jump is unlikely to last.

theses.name: Henry Schein, Inc.

theses.name: Corpay, Inc.

signals.name: elevated_incentives
signals.rationale: Incentives ran 10.4% of price and management expects them to stay elevated given affordability and high mortgage rates.

theses.name: Steel Dynamics, Inc.

theses.name: First Solar, Inc.

signals.name: glj_target_cut

theses.name: Equifax Inc.

signals.rationale: Doubled its AI-driven cost reduction target to $150M and agreed to acquire Mexico's Círculo de Crédito.

signals.name: medicaid_supplemental
signals.rationale: Booked about $400M of incremental net benefit from Medicaid supplemental payment programs, mainly Florida, offsetting the uninsured drag.

theses.name: Coinbase Global, Inc.

theses.name: O'Reilly Automotive, Inc.
